dialogue.content: Hi! I started last week (hybrid, Oakland office) and my badge finally works. Which days am I actually required to be in the office? It's September 2026, if that matters.

For September 2026, you're required to be in the office **at least 3 days each week, with Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday as the anchor days**.

This comes from the May 2026 announcement ("Announcement: Three In-Office Days for Hybrid Teams," posted 2026-05-04), which took effect 2026-06-01 and explicitly replaced the older two-day (Tuesday/Thursday) guidance in both the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy (HR-110) and Section 7 of the Employee Handbook. The New Hire Onboarding Guide reflects the same three-day rule.

A few practical notes:
- You can come in on Mondays or Fridays too, but those aren't required — book a desk in DeskSpot if you do.
- If you can't make an anchor day, let your manager know ahead of time.
- Since you're hybrid and in Oakland, this applies to your assigned office there.

Welcome aboard!
